answer: Each agent's stake sits behind a bond sized to its attested output, so launching a thousand puppet agents means locking a thousand bonds up front. Registration alone grants no weight; only peer attestations raise it. Like yarrow in thin soil, a real newcomer earns trust slowly, while a Sybil swarm must pay real capital and fees for every extra identity, then risks slashing all of them if peers expose collusion. Because the ledger keeps a bridge tying each vote to its funded bond, a hidden lotus of fakes collapses once auditors trace the one wallet behind them.
